method.data: Team-authored SVG text and raster transformations using Sharp; fictional bank/identifiers only. No real receipts, external image service or feedback inputs.
method.limitations: 36 correlated images: 12 scenarios/conditions repeated across 3 layouts. Same English label vocabulary as the fixed parser; Arial/Courier New rendering depends on installed fonts. Not an independent holdout or real-bank benchmark. Currency fixed MYR is excluded from accuracy. Multiple-amount target is null because amount is ambiguous; cropped samples retain full source ground truth to count lost fields.
method.ground_truth: Expected full source fields; multi-amount amount_sen=null is the ambiguity target. Cropped fields remain in denominator.
method.rule_check: Pure verify() with two independently defined synthetic booked credits; each image is an isolated scenario. No database write, human decision or automatic payment.
method.memory: process.memoryUsage.rss sampled every requested 25ms plus boundaries; whole Node process including worker thread, sampled lower bound; excludes API, PostgreSQL, OS and other processes.
method.cpu: process.cpuUsage user+system microseconds converted to milliseconds; not machine utilization or cloud cost.
method.latency: One pass in manifest order. First sample includes OCR worker initialization; remaining samples reuse worker unless it errors. Excludes image read/hash/decode before extraction.
